changelog:
v1.13.0 In-App Custom Tabs & Couples Co-op Games:
• In-App Branded Tabs: Seamlessly play web arcade classics, host party lobbies, and join room PINs inside the app using Chrome Custom Tabs
• Couples & Co-op Category: Added Word Bond: Duet and Team Crossword for live partner play
• Caption This Party Room: Added quirky caption competition room to party games
• One-Tap Return: Branded in-app navigation keeps users inside EchoWithin without bouncing to external browsers
